name: Neferu
source:
The second son of the Pharaoh of Khemia, sent to Adastra to broker an alliance with the wolves.

[spoiler]Despite being the second-born son of the Pharaoh, he lives in the shadow of both his older brother and his two younger sisters. He wants to secure the Adastran-Khemian alliance primarily because it is a ostensibly impossible task assigned to him by his family and he wishes to prove himself by accomplishing it against all odds. This is why he privately supports Amicus' claim to the throne and secretly works with Virginia in Amicus' interest.[/spoiler]
